title: Pulsar timing arrays use many pulsars to detect gravitational waves.
narration: Gravitational wave research has expanded beyond ground-based detectors. Pulsar timing arrays now use many pulsars across the galaxy to create a huge gravitational wave observatory. By timing these cosmic clocks precisely, scientists hope to detect very low frequency ripples in spacetime. This technique promises to open a new window on the universe.
